query.text: 请协助我安全行走和过街，提供路线引导，有障碍物或危险及时提醒，完成后帮我总结行程。
query.text_en: Please help me walk and cross streets safely, provide route guidance, alert me to obstacles or dangers, and summarize the journey when it is finished.

annotation.text_zh: 前方是红绿灯柱，可以按下过街按钮
annotation.text_en: There's a traffic light pole ahead, you can press the button to cross.

annotation.text_zh: 前方有车辆通过，请在路边等待
annotation.text_en: Traffic passing ahead, please wait by the roadside.

annotation.text_zh: 有一名行人从你身边走过
前方仍有车辆通过，请继续等待
annotation.text_en: Cars are still passing ahead, please keep waiting.

annotation.text_zh: 前方有车辆通过，请在路边等待
annotation.text_en: Traffic passing ahead, please wait by the roadside.

annotation.text_zh: 前方车辆已通过，可以安全过马路了
annotation.text_en: The traffic has cleared, it's safe to cross now.

annotation.text_zh: 已到达安全岛，请调整方向准备第二次过街
annotation.text_en: You've reached the safety island, get ready to cross the next street.

annotation.text_zh: 前方有车辆通过，请在安全岛等待
annotation.text_en: Traffic passing ahead, please wait on the safety island.

annotation.text_zh: 前方车辆已通过，可以安全过马路了
annotation.text_en: The traffic has cleared, it's safe to cross now.

annotation.text_zh: 你已成功安全通过两次马路
annotation.text_en: You've successfully crossed the street twice.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
